purpose: Refreshed non-destructive lexical screen of all 55 current replacement proposals against all 1,600 source question rows, including retained and held rows; includes DUP-54/55.
method: Normalize each stem to lowercase alphanumeric words, pad the string, create unique character trigrams, and calculate Dice similarity against same-subject source stems. Scores at or above 0.42 are review prompts only, not semantic duplicate verdicts.
